paintBall.title: Paintball
paintBall.description1: Step Into the Action. Gear up for heart-pounding paintball battles!
paintBall.description2: Dive into the excitement of our Paintball Adventure Packages, designed for groups ranging from 1 to 25 players. Choose from different packages based on the number of paintballs you want—150, 250, or 350—to suit your play style and game intensity. Our well-maintained equipment and safety gear ensure a safe and thrilling experience for beginners and seasoned players alike.

keyFeatures.title: Key
keyFeatures.one: Suitable for all skill levels: Beginner to Pro
keyFeatures.two: Comprehensive safety briefing before the game
keyFeatures.three: Quality markers and protective gear provided
keyFeatures.five: Flexible packages to fit your group size and game preferences

whatsIncluded.title: What's
whatsIncluded.two: Number of Paintballs per chosen package

paintBall.callToActionDescription: Gear up and book your Paintball Adventure now! Perfect for friends, family, or team-building events — experience adrenaline-pumping fun in a safe environment.
paintBall.name: Your Full Name

karting.title: Karting
karting.description1: Feel the Rush, Own the Track! Race through curves and unleash your inner racer in the ultimate karting challenge.
karting.description2: Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping Go-Kart racing experience! Our fleet of 1 to 25 go-karts is perfect for beginners and seasoned racers alike. Whether you want a quick 20-minute sprint or a longer 40-minute race, our well-maintained karts deliver thrilling speed, precision handling, and maximum fun on our professional race tracks.

keyFeatures.title: Key Features:
keyFeatures.one: Suitable for all skill levels: Beginner to Pro
keyFeatures.three: Electric/ Petrol engines (depending on kart type)
keyFeatures.four: Age and height restrictions apply for safety

karting.callToActionDescription: Ready to race? Book your Go-Kart session now and experience the excitement of high-speed racing with friends and family!
karting.name: Your Full Name

motoMiniGp.title: Moto Mini Gp
motoMiniGp.description1: Where Future Champions Begin! Perfect for aspiring riders and young speed lovers.
motoMiniGp.description2: Get ready for a thrilling ride with our Moto Mini GP Racing Experience! Designed for riders aged 5 and above, this exciting mini motorcycle race offers the perfect adrenaline rush for both beginners and experienced riders. With a safe and controlled environment, you can enjoy 20 minutes of high-speed fun on our professional mini GP track.

keyFeatures.title: Key Features:
keyFeatures.two: Perfect for beginners and intermediate riders
keyFeatures.four: Expert supervision and safety briefing included
keyFeatures.five: Group bookings available for up to 25 players

motoMiniGp.callToActionDescription: Ready to race like a pro? Book your Moto Mini GP session today and experience the excitement of mini motorcycle racing!
motoMiniGp.name: Your Full Name

camelRide.title: Camel Ride
camelRide.description1: Ride Through Time on the Ship of the Desert! Slow down, breathe in, and connect with the golden sand.
camelRide.description2: Enjoy a traditional and serene Camel Ride experience in the heart of the desert. Perfect for all ages, this 10-minute ride offers a unique chance to connect with nature and explore the beautiful sandy dunes at a relaxed pace. Ideal for families, couples, and solo travelers seeking an authentic Arabian adventure.

keyFeatures.title: Key Features:
keyFeatures.four: Perfect for quick desert exploration and photo opportunities

camelRide.callToActionDescription: Experience the magic of the desert on a camel’s back! Book your Camel Ride now for a peaceful and memorable journey.
camelRide.name: Your Full Name
